items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: So Peter Bocars and Captain Johnny come to the house.

ctx.x: Guitar. Well he played piano out there. No, he played guitar because he had two guitars and two, because Steve Lewis was on piano. Steve Lewis. Yeah. Well I quit the job out there because I didn't like the way he was serving the fish and stuff that they supposed to give us. I didn't like the way he was serving. And he was giving us a nice way to go. I quit. So I quit like on a Wednesday night, and the whole band quit that Saturday night. So I'm sitting down home. So Peter Bocars and Captain Johnny come to the…
Well, he must have been a pretty old man by this time. Huh? Charlie McCurdis was pretty old probably by this time.

items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: So I carried Johnny Strick was down there and enlisted Louie.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know Baby told me that you got him on the job.

I got Baby Dots, see. So we was getting around the end of the season we wanted another trumpet player. So Louie was playing with the O-Rey band down on Claiborne Street. Pete Laudas had a little dance hall. So I carried Johnny Strick was down there and enlisted Louie. He wanted Louie. And Louie come on the boat. So Louie moves music that he learned, he should give Joe Howard, the trumpet player, very good trumpet player. He's from up around St. John's, Louisiana. Him from St. John's, Louisiana.
